Overview

Lanzhou is a city in Gansu with a population of 4,359,000. A historic Silk Road city on the Yellow River, famous for its hand-pulled beef noodles and gateway to the Gobi Desert. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
